title: [PM seat] domain:devx @ objectstack — ⏳ vacant
body:
## 1. Current PM — ⏳ vacant

- **Vacated** 2026-10-14T01:51Z on the maintainer's word 「你可以下班了」.
- **Previous holder:** GitHub `zhuangjianguo`, `session_012zwsLMxQBwHUYJgPyrpEvx`, seat `domain:devx#1`. Seated 2026-10-12T13:57Z. That shift's working ledger is the previous body revision. The closing brief is the last comment on this thread.
- **Timers:** none. Routine `trig_01PgYnopVxJWwXKxNcYgP9NT` was deleted at clock-out. **PR subscriptions:** none open. **Dev sessions:** none in flight (every `os-dev` was an in-session subagent and has returned).
- **To take the seat:** `/pm-dispatch devx`, reading this post first. Write channel: the fleet relay (`objectstack-fleet[bot]`), via `post-stamped` / `label-write` / `fleet-write`.
- **Standing maintainer order (`6146552291`): serial dispatch**, one dev in flight per seat.

## 2. Ledger (snapshot at clock-out)

**Tails a successor owns.** None needs a stay-behind; each is a reading or a maintainer act.
- **#23282 live pin** (card closed, landing `6158386202`). PR #23313 (`c4ef17a0cc`, `changesets/action` pinned to v2.1.2 plus a read rehearsal) merged 00:49Z, maintainer ruling A. The first GitHub-side reading is the next 6-hourly scheduled `Release` tick, or a maintainer-run `refresh_version_pr`. Pass means three things: the version-PR lane opens `chore: version packages (next)` for `18.0.0-next.1`, the rehearsal answers `has-changesets=false`, and Validate is green. Record the run on #23282; a red reopens it. ⛔ No seat dispatches `release.yml` while PD15 is open, and no seat merges, queues or arms the Version PR.
- **#23193 → PR #23209** (draft, unarmed). It lets the relay start `release.yml` with `refresh_version_pr`. It is held because ruling B item 5 contradicts AGENTS.md PD15 as written (`6141962120`). Options A/B/C are on the card; this seat recommends A. The card stays `pm:dispatched` until the ruling.
- **#23169** (`pm:blocked`, 58 of 61 rows landed): the `platform-core.lifecycle-retention-sweep` steps[4] row waits on decision `6147446653` (A recommended).
- **#23177** (gate strictness, ruled B `6139629628`): A1 and A2′ have landed. **B′** (an audit card) is owed after next ships plus two weeks of A1 on the full battery. Item 4 is #23201 (skills lane, PR #23257). Item 5 is #23193 above.

**Queue:** no dispatchable `domain:devx` card at clock-out (`pm:queue` is empty).

**Standing states:**
- `pm:blocked`: #15214.
- `pm:on-hold`: #22034.
- Graded, no state label: #13980 (p3).
- Ungraded tracking: #8249, #7849, #3877.
- In flight on another seat: #22085 (seat 2, `os-justin`).

**Closed this shift (since the previous body revision):**

- **#23185**

- **#23288** → PR #23333

- `18.0.0-next.0` was published 08:43Z (round report `6141791182`).

**Cross-lane memos filed this shift:**
- **#23328** (`domain:services`, p2): a password-protected `signed_in` share link, opened anonymously with the correct password, answers `WRONG_PASSWORD`. The arm order is security-relevant (password oracle).
- **#23335** (`domain:spec`, p1, `security`): the auth-namespace exemption admits the platform-admin mounts, whose judge reads no ADR-0069 posture. Measure first, then the maintainer's boundary call.
- **#23276** (skills): its remove list needs `objectstack-pm-dispatch` (11 names, `6148721272`).
- **#15204** (epic): four catalog residues (`6153183769`), among them the inert `adminScope.manageBindings` / `authorEnvironmentSets`.
- **#23231** (engine): it shares the `content/docs/permissions/*` pages (`6149658350`).

## 3. Hot-file serial queue

⛔ Re-derive this from live `Claim:` comments and each open PR's actual file list before every dispatch; never from this list.

| file / surface | held by |
|:--|:--|
| `scripts/pm/fleet-write/{dispatch,execute,ops,validate}.mjs` | PR #23209 (#23193, draft, held on PD15) |
| `.github/workflows/release.yml` | free (#23282 landed as `c4ef17a0cc`) |

## 4. Notes

- Round markers and round reports go on this thread; states live on cards.
- The director's reminder `5903810733` (the contract-review record must be on the landing head) applies at every enqueue.
- Carried: `dogfood-gate`'s two comments in `ci.yml` (from PR #22666) still describe the cancel-cause reads as serving the single-leg question only. Since PR #22685 they also serve a partially attested dogfood matrix. Carrier: the next PR touching that job.
- Carried, open to the maintainer: the example-CRM line count on three pages reads 1,932 against the stated 1,929.
- Carried, pointer `6110276158`: the approvals checklist item's empty-slate fork still reads "decidable only via the #3424 privileged override" (`approvals.json` `:1237`, `:1266`). Carrier: the next checklist-author sweep of the approvals area.
- Carried, noted not filed: `plugin-auth/src/invitation-role-cap.ts:22-25` gives the stale "`GOVERNED_OBJECTS` does not cover `sys_member`" reason that PR #23341 corrected in the docs. Carrier: the next PR touching that file.
